```cypher
MATCH (paymob:Plugin {component: 'paygw_paymob'})-[:CO_MAINTAINED]-(communityPlugin:Plugin)
WHERE communityPlugin.louvain_soc = paymob.louvain_soc
WITH communityPlugin
MATCH (communityPlugin)-[:MAINTAINS]->(maintainer:Maintainer)
WITH communityPlugin, COLLECT(maintainer) AS maintainers
WHERE SIZE(maintainers) = 1
  AND communityPlugin.last_release_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND communityPlugin.last_release_ts < (apoc.date.parse('2026-09-10', 's', 'yyyy-MM-dd') - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60))
RETURN communityPlugin.component, communityPlugin.name, [m IN maintainers | m.display_name] AS maintainerNames, communityPlugin.last_release_ts
ORDER BY communityPlugin.name
LIMIT 100
```
